create_demuxer_query_codec: create a Demuxer from a media file and query its audio and video codec properties
demux_video_with_fraction_window: demux video packets from a file using Fraction timestamps for precise time window selection
demux_audio_with_fraction_window: demux audio packets from a file using Fraction timestamps for precise time window selection
demux_video_module_level: demux video packets from a file path or bytes using the module-level demux_video function with a custom name
demux_image_module_level: demux image packets from a file path or bytes using the module-level demux_image function with a custom name
